verses.sloka: तथा विप्रेक्षमाणस्य वनम् पुष्पितपादपम् ।विचिन्वतश्च वैदेहीम् किंचिच्चेषा निशाभवत् ।। ५-१८-१।।
verses.transliteration: tathā viprekṣamāṇasya vanam puṣpitapādapam ।vicinvataśca vaidehīm kiṁcicceṣā niśābhavat ।। 5-18-1।।

translations.english: The night came to a close while Hanuman went searching and looking for Sita at Ashoka grove full of flowering trees.
translations.hindi: पुष्पित वृक्षों से युक्त भ्रशोकवाटिका को देखते-देखते ग्रौर सीता को खोजते' खोजते अ्रब थोड़ी ही रात शेष रह गई थी

verses.sloka: षडङ्गवेदविदुषाम् क्रतुप्रवरयाजिनाम् ।शुश्राव ब्रह्मघोषान् स विरात्रे ब्रह्मरक्षसाम् ।। ५-१८-२।।
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍaṅgavedaviduṣām kratupravarayājinām ।śuśrāva brahmaghoṣān sa virātre brahmarakṣasām ।। 5-18-2।।

translations.english: At dawn sounds of recitation of Vedas and the six auxillary sciences, (i.e .grammar, prosody, etymology, phonetics, astronomy and the science of rituals) by the brahmins among demons wellversed in performing exalted sacrificial ceremonies were heard.
translations.hindi: रात बीतने पर षडङ्गवेदो के ज्ञाता श्रौर उत्तमोत्तम यज्ञों के करने वाले ब्राह्मण राक्षसों के वेदपाठ की घ्वनि, हनुमानजी ने सुनी

verses.sloka: अथ मङ्गलवादित्रशब्दैः श्रुतिमनोहरैः ।प्रबुध्यत महाबाहुर्दशग्रीवो महाबलः ।। ५-१८-३।।
verses.transliteration: atha maṅgalavāditraśabdaiḥ śrutimanoharaiḥ ।prabudhyata mahābāhurdaśagrīvo mahābalaḥ ।। 5-18-3।।

translations.english: By that time the strongarmed, powerful, tennecked Ravana was awakened by the delightful sounds of auspicious musical instruments.
translations.hindi: नोट--इससे जान पड़ता है कि लंका में चारों वर्ण के राक्षस थे श्रौर यज्ञ करने और पडङ्कवेदाध्ययन करने वाले ब्राह्मण राक्षस भी वहाँ रहा करते थे । “ब्रह्मरक्षसाम्‌” का ्रथं गोविन्दराज जी ने “'्राह्मणत्वविशिष्टरक्षसाम्‌?' किया है । यही भ्रर्थ यूक्तियुवत जान पड़ता है । ब्राह्मण और राक्षस ये दोनों बातें परस्पर विरोध रखने वाली हूँ । हाँ कोई कोई जीव राक्षस योनि में जन्म लेकर भी पूवं जन्म के संस्कारवश ब्राह्मणत्वयुबत हो सकता है । यह भी सम्भव है कि रावण, पुलस्त्य वंशी ऋषि सन्तान था; किन्तु कर्म राक्षसों जसे किया करता था तो भी अपने वंश की मर्यादा की रक्षा के हेतु उसे ब्राह्मणों की भ्रावश्यकता पड़ती थी--ग्रतः राजपौरोहित्य के प्रलोभन में पड़, कतिपय राक्षसों ने ब्राह्मण वृत्ति स्वीकार कर ली हो--श्रतः उनको ही ग्रादि कवि ने “ब्रह्म रक्षसाम्‌” लिखा है । ] ग्रथ मङ्गलवादित्रैः शब्दैः श्रोत्रमनोहरेः । प्राबुध्यत महाबाहुर्दशग्रीवो महाबलः

verses.sloka: विबुध्य तु यथाकालम् राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् ।स्रस्तमाल्याम्बरधरो वैदेहीमन्वचिन्तयात् ।। ५-१८-४।।
verses.transliteration: vibudhya tu yathākālam rākṣasendraḥ pratāpavān ।srastamālyāmbaradharo vaidehīmanvacintayāt ।। 5-18-4।।

translations.english: The chivalrous lord of demons woke up as usual.His raiment and garland were still in disarray and he thought of Vaidehi.
translations.hindi: यथासमय प्रतापी रावण सो कर उठ बैठा श्रौर सोते में खसकी हुई मालाओं ्रौर वस्त्रों को सम्हालता हुश्रा वह सीता के विषय में सोचने विचारने लगा

verses.sloka: भृशं नियुक्तस्तस्याम् च मदनेन मदोत्कटः ।न स तं राक्षसः कामं शशाकात्मनि गूहितुम् ।। ५-१८-५।।
verses.transliteration: bhṛśaṁ niyuktastasyām ca madanena madotkaṭaḥ ।na sa taṁ rākṣasaḥ kāmaṁ śaśākātmani gūhitum ।। 5-18-5।।

translations.english: The demon king who was unable to hide his great passion and control his senses was drawn towards Sita, in his state of intoxication.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि वह रावण भ्रत्यन्त कामासक्त था अतः उसकी सीता में अत्यन्त प्रासक्ति थी । साथ ही वह अपने काम-वेग को रोकने में सर्वथा असमर्थ था

verses.sloka: स सर्वाभरणैर्युक्तो बिभच्छ्रियमनुत्तमाम् ।तां नगैर्बहुभिर्जुष्टाम् सर्वपुष्पफलोपगैः ।। ५-१८-६।।
verses.transliteration: sa sarvābharaṇairyukto bibhacchriyamanuttamām ।tāṁ nagairbahubhirjuṣṭām sarvapuṣpaphalopagaiḥ ।। 5-18-6।।

translations.english: Adorned with all ornaments and glowing with excellent splendour he went through the path filled with trees flourishing with all kinds of flowers and fruits.
translations.hindi: रावण समस्त भ्राभूषणों को पहिनने के कारण भ्रपूवं शोमा धारण कर, सर्वऋतु में फलने-फूलने वाले वृक्षों से युक्त

verses.sloka: वृतां पुष्करिणीभिश्च नानापुष्पोपशोभिताम् ।सदामदैश्च विहगैर्विचित्राम् परमाद्भुताम् ।। ५-१८-७।।
verses.transliteration: vṛtāṁ puṣkariṇībhiśca nānāpuṣpopaśobhitām ।sadāmadaiśca vihagairvicitrām paramādbhutām ।। 5-18-7।।

translations.english: Ponds covered with a variety of beautiful flowers and colourful birds always cheerful looked very wonderful.
translations.hindi: मानो उस समय वह मनोरथों के सङ्कूल्पर्पी घोड़ों पर सवार हो, प्रसिद्ध राजसिह श्रीरामचन्द्रजी के पास जा रही थी

verses.sloka: ईहामृगैश्च विविधैर्जुष्टां डृष्टिमनोहरैः ।वीथीः संप्रेक्षमाणश्च मणिकाञ्चनतोरणाः ।। ५-१८-८।।
verses.transliteration: īhāmṛgaiśca vividhairjuṣṭāṁ ḍṛṣṭimanoharaiḥ ।vīthīḥ saṁprekṣamāṇaśca maṇikāñcanatoraṇāḥ ।। 5-18-8।।

translations.english: Watching the garden filled with trees, gateways ornamented with gold and gems, he entered through the pleasant pathways in the Ashoka garden. There were wonderful wolves and several herds of animals in the garden. Fruits dropped from trees were strewn all over.
translations.hindi: तथा अनेक प्रकार के बनैले जन्तुओं से युक्त, चुए हुए पके फलों से भरे-पूरे और सघन वृक्षों से पूर्ण, उस श्रशोक्रवाटिका में पहुंचा

verses.sloka: नानामृगगणाकीर्णां फलैः प्रपतितैर्वृताम् ।अशोकवनकामेव प्राविशत्संततद्रुमाम् ।। ५-१८-९।।
verses.transliteration: nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇāṁ phalaiḥ prapatitairvṛtām ।aśokavanakāmeva prāviśatsaṁtatadrumām ।। 5-18-9।।

translations.english: Watching the garden filled with trees, gateways ornamented with gold and gems, he entered through the pleasant pathways in the Ashoka garden. There were wonderful wolves and several herds of animals in the garden. Fruits dropped from trees were strewn all over.

verses.sloka: अङ्गनाशतमात्रं तु तं व्रजन्तमनुव्रजत् ।महेन्द्रमिव पौलस्त्यम्ं देवगन्धर्वयोषितः ।। ५-१८-१०।।
verses.transliteration: aṅganāśatamātraṁ tu taṁ vrajantamanuvrajat ।mahendramiva paulastyamṁ devagandharvayoṣitaḥ ।। 5-18-10।।

translations.english: Ravana, son of sage Paulasti, was followed by a hundred women, just as Indra is trailed by the females of gods and gandharvas.
translations.hindi: C00. पारे RE, ७७२ प्रात फेल रस्मीएक्ानकह्योस्या: । उसके पीछे-पीछे संकड़ों स्त्रियां भी वैसे ही चली जाती थीं जैसे देवता और. गन्धवों की स्त्रियां इन्द्र के पीछे चलती हैं

verses.sloka: दीपिकाः काञ्चनीः काश्चिज्जगृहुस्तत्र योषितः ।वालव्यजनहस्ताश्च तालवृन्तानि चापराः ।। ५-१८-११।।
verses.transliteration: dīpikāḥ kāñcanīḥ kāścijjagṛhustatra yoṣitaḥ ।vālavyajanahastāśca tālavṛntāni cāparāḥ ।। 5-18-11।।

translations.english: Some women carried golden lamps, some held yalk tail fans in their hands while others bore palmleaf fans.
translations.hindi: किसी-किसी स्त्री के हाय में सुवर्ण के दीपक (प्रर्थात्‌ लालटैन) किसी के हाथ में चेवर श्रौर किसी के हाथ में ताइ के पंखे थे

verses.sloka: काञ्चनैरपि भृङ्गारैर्जह्रुः सलिलमग्रतः ।मण्डलागान् ब्रुसींश्चापि गृह्यान्याः पृष्ठतो ययुः ।। ५-१८-१२।।
verses.transliteration: kāñcanairapi bhṛṅgārairjahruḥ salilamagrataḥ ।maṇḍalāgān brusīṁścāpi gṛhyānyāḥ pṛṣṭhato yayuḥ ।। 5-18-12।।

translations.english: Some moved ahead of him carrying water in golden pitchers. Others followed him carrying circular couches (to be used as seats).
translations.hindi: कोई-कोई जल से भरी सुवर्ण को झारी हाथ में लिये हुए आगे चलती थीं ग्रौर कोई गोल प्रासन लिए हुए, पीछे चली जाती थीं

verses.sloka: काचिद्रत्नमयीं स्थालीं पूर्णां पानस्य ब्राजतम् ।दक्षिणा दक्षिणेनैव तदा जग्राह पाणिना ।। ५-१८-१३।।
verses.transliteration: kācidratnamayīṁ sthālīṁ pūrṇāṁ pānasya brājatam ।dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇenaiva tadā jagrāha pāṇinā ।। 5-18-13।।

translations.english: One glorious and compassionate lady carried in her right hand a gemstudded jar filled with wine.
translations.hindi: कोई-कोई चतुर स्त्री दाहिने हाथ में मदिरा से भरी साफ रत्नजटित सुराही लिये हुए चली जाती थी

verses.sloka: राजहंसप्रतीकाशं चत्रं पूर्णशशिप्रभम् ।सौवर्णदण्डमपरा गृहीत्वा पृष्ठतो ययौ ।। ५-१८-१४।।
verses.transliteration: rājahaṁsapratīkāśaṁ catraṁ pūrṇaśaśiprabham ।sauvarṇadaṇḍamaparā gṛhītvā pṛṣṭhato yayau ।। 5-18-14।।

translations.english: Another shedemon moved behind him holding an umbrella with a golden handle which was white like a royal swan and bright like the fullmoon.
translations.hindi: कोई राजहंस को तरह सफेद और पूर्णमासी के चन्द्रमा की तरह गोल श्रौर सोने की डंडी बाला छत्र रावण के ऊपर ताने हुए उसके पीछे जा रही थी

verses.sloka: निद्रामदपरीताक्ष्यो रावनस्योत्तमाः स्त्रियः ।अनुजग्मुः पतिं वीरम् घनम् विद्युल्लता इव ।। ५-१८-१५।।
verses.transliteration: nidrāmadaparītākṣyo rāvanasyottamāḥ striyaḥ ।anujagmuḥ patiṁ vīram ghanam vidyullatā iva ।। 5-18-15।।

translations.english: The chief wives of Ravana with eyes dizzy with sleep and drinking followed their heroic husband like streaks of lightning follow a thunder cloud. (Ravana who was dark looked like a cloud and the women with dazzling golden complexion appeared like lightning.)
translations.hindi: अथवा टूटी हुई पंखड़ियों का कमल, भयभीत पक्षी और 'हाथी की सूड से खलबलाई हुई कमलयुक्त पुष्करिणी

verses.sloka: व्याविद्धहारकेयूराः समामृदितवर्णकाः ।समागळितकेशान्ताः सस्वेदवदनास्तथा ।। ५-१८-१६।।
verses.transliteration: vyāviddhahārakeyūrāḥ samāmṛditavarṇakāḥ ।samāgaḻitakeśāntāḥ sasvedavadanāstathā ।। 5-18-16।।

translations.english: The necklaces and armlets (of the wives) disarrayed, the sandal paste and other unguents on the body smudged, hair hanging down their faces, the sweating damsels followed Ravana. They were dizzy with leftover intoxication and sleep and were swaying from side to side. Their dishevelled hair was loose and faces filled with sweat, their flower garlands on the body had wilted due to sweat on their limbs. The drunken wives of Ravana, actuated by their high regard and passion for him followed as he advanced with drunken eyes.
translations.hindi: उत स्त्रियों की कण्ठमालाए भौर बाजूबंद प्रपने-प्रपने स्थानों से कुछ कुछ खसक गए थे भ्रौर उलट-पूलट गए थे । उनमें से घ्रनेक के प्रंगराग छूट गए थे, उनके सिरों के जूड़े खुल गए थे घ्रौर उनके मुखों पर पसीने की बूदें झलक रही थीं

verses.sloka: घोर्णन्त्यो मदशेषेण निद्रया च शुभाननाः ।स्वेदक्लिष्टाङ्गकुसुमाः सुमाल्याकुलमूर्धजाः ।। ५-१८-१७।।
verses.transliteration: ghorṇantyo madaśeṣeṇa nidrayā ca śubhānanāḥ ।svedakliṣṭāṅgakusumāḥ sumālyākulamūrdhajāḥ ।। 5-18-17।।

translations.english: The necklaces and armlets (of the wives) disarrayed, the sandal paste and other unguents on the body smudged, hair hanging down their faces, the sweating damsels followed Ravana. They were dizzy with leftover intoxication and sleep and were swaying from side to side. Their dishevelled hair was loose and faces filled with sweat, their flower garlands on the body had wilted due to sweat on their limbs. The drunken wives of Ravana, actuated by their high regard and passion for him followed as he advanced with drunken eyes.
translations.hindi: घर्णन्त्यो मदशेषेण निद्रया च शुभाननाः । स्वेदक्लिष्टाङ्गकुसुसा: सुमाल्याकुलमूर्घेजा: (३१७१ वे सुन्दरी स्त्रियां तशो की और नींद की खुमारी से डगमगाती, पसीने से भींगे फूलों को धारण किए तथा जूड़ों में फूल सजाए हुए थीं

verses.sloka: प्रयान्तं नैरृतपतिं नार्यो मदिरलोचनाः ।बहुमानाच्च कामाच्च प्रिया भार्यास्तमन्वयुः ।। ५-१८-१८।।
verses.transliteration: prayāntaṁ nairṛtapatiṁ nāryo madiralocanāḥ ।bahumānācca kāmācca priyā bhāryāstamanvayuḥ ।। 5-18-18।।

translations.english: The necklaces and armlets (of the wives) disarrayed, the sandal paste and other unguents on the body smudged, hair hanging down their faces, the sweating damsels followed Ravana. They were dizzy with leftover intoxication and sleep and were swaying from side to side. Their dishevelled hair was loose and faces filled with sweat, their flower garlands on the body had wilted due to sweat on their limbs. The drunken wives of Ravana, actuated by their high regard and passion for him followed as he advanced with drunken eyes.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार मदमाते नैनों वाली वे सब स्त्रियां, श्रति श्रादर के साथ प्रीर कामपीडित हो, भ्रपने पति के पीछे-पीछे चली जाती थीं

verses.sloka: स च कामपराधीनः पतिस्तासां महाबलः ।सीतासक्तमना मन्दो मन्दाञ्चितगतिर्बभौ ।। ५-१८-१९।।
verses.transliteration: sa ca kāmaparādhīnaḥ patistāsāṁ mahābalaḥ ।sītāsaktamanā mando mandāñcitagatirbabhau ।। 5-18-19।।

translations.english: Their husband, powerful Ravana under the control of passion looking dull, absorbed in the thoughts of Sita walked slowly as though counting his steps.

verses.sloka: ततः काञ्चीनिनादं च नूपुराणाम् च निस्वनम् ।शुश्राव परमस्त्रीणां स कपिर्मारुतात्मजः ।। ५-१८-२०।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kāñcīninādaṁ ca nūpurāṇām ca nisvanam ।śuśrāva paramastrīṇāṁ sa kapirmārutātmajaḥ ।। 5-18-20।।

translations.english: Then Hanuman, son of the Windgod, heard their jingling golden girdles and anklets.
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे--“गृहिता मालितां” ! २ ब्रल्पाहारां-तोयमात्राहारा- उपवास, शोक, चिन्ता प्रौर भय के कारण सीता का क्षरीर प्रत्यन्त दुबला-पतला हौ रहा था । यह केवल जलमात्र पी कर शरीर को तपा रही थी, भ्रर्थात्‌ कष्ट दे रही थीं

verses.sloka: तं चाप्रतिमकर्माणमचिन्त्यबलपौरुषम् ।द्वारदेशमनुप्राप्तं ददर्श हनुमान् कपिः ।। ५-१८-२१।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ cāpratimakarmāṇamacintyabalapauruṣam ।dvāradeśamanuprāptaṁ dadarśa hanumān kapiḥ ।। 5-18-21।।

translations.english: Then Hanuman, the Vanara saw Ravana of extraordinary deeds, and of unimaginable strength and valour at the entrance (of Ashoka garden)
translations.hindi: Vinay Aves Seer A १५७०, हनुमानजी ने देखा कि, वह अनुपम कर्मा, भ्रचिन्त्य एवं प्रसाधारण वल धरोर पुरुषार्थ से युक्त रावण, उस वाटिका के द्वार पर भ्रा पहुँचा: है

verses.sloka: दीपिकाभिरनेकाभिः समन्तादवभासितम् ।गन्धतैलावसिक्ताभिर्द्रियमाणाभिरग्रतः ।। ५-१८-२२।।
verses.transliteration: dīpikābhiranekābhiḥ samantādavabhāsitam ।gandhatailāvasiktābhirdriyamāṇābhiragrataḥ ।। 5-18-22।।

translations.english: Hanuman saw him in the glow of lamps wet with fragrant oil carried by many shedemons all over.
translations.hindi: भागे रागे सुगन्धित तेल से पुर्ण भ्रनेक लालटैनों या मशालों के प्रकाश: में रावण का समस्त शरीर भली भाँति दिखलाई पड़ रहा था

verses.sloka: कामदर्पमदैर्युक्तं जिह्मताम्रायतेक्षणम् ।समक्षमिव कन्दर्पमपविद्धशरासनम् ।। ५-१८-२३।।
verses.transliteration: kāmadarpamadairyuktaṁ jihmatāmrāyatekṣaṇam ।samakṣamiva kandarpamapaviddhaśarāsanam ।। 5-18-23।।

translations.english: Hanuman saw him, who was possessed of lust, arrogance and intoxication. He appeared like Cupid setting aside his quiver and arrows with his curved, big, red eyes.
translations.hindi: उस समय रावण नश में चूर था और काममद से पीडित था । उसके विशाल तिरछौहे नेत्र लाल हो रहे थे। उस समय वह एसा जान पड़ता था मानो साक्षात्‌ कामदेव धनुष को दूर फेक कर, सामने चला भ्राता हो

verses.sloka: मथितामृतफेनाभमरजोवस्त्रमुत्तमम् ।सलीलमनुकर्षन्तं विमुक्तं सक्तमङ्गदे ।। ५-१८-२४।।
verses.transliteration: mathitāmṛtaphenābhamarajovastramuttamam ।salīlamanukarṣantaṁ vimuktaṁ saktamaṅgade ।। 5-18-24।।

translations.english: He was playfully pulling up his upper garment that slipped and stuck to his armlet. This excellent unsoiled robe was looking like the foam of churned nectar.
translations.hindi: मथे हुए अमृत के झागों की तरह ग्रति उजला तथा भ्रति उत्तम वस्त्र, जो खसक कर उसके बाजूबन्द में श्रटक गया था, उसे साधारणतया खींच करः यथास्थान. उसने रख लिया

verses.sloka: तं पत्रविटपे लीनः अत्रपुष्पघनावृतह् ।समीपमिव संक्रान्तं निध्यातुमुपचक्रमे ।। ५-१८-२५।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ patraviṭape līnaḥ atrapuṣpaghanāvṛtah ।samīpamiva saṁkrāntaṁ nidhyātumupacakrame ।। 5-18-25।।

translations.english: Hanuman seated on a leafy branch (of the simsupa tree) thickly covered with leaves and flowers started scanning the identity of Ravana who was drawing nearer.
translations.hindi: रावण ज्यों-ज्यों समीप ग्राता जाता था, त्योंत्यों हनुमानजी उस सघन पेड़ के फूल-पत्तों में भ्रपने शरीर को छिपाते जाते थे और छिपे-छिपे ही वह यह भी जानना चाहते थे कि, सामने भ्राता हुश्रा व्यवित कौन है

verses.sloka: अवेक्षमाणस्तु ततो ददर्श कपिकुञ्जरः ।रूपयौवनसंपन्ना रावणस्य वरस्तियः ।। ५-१८-२६।।
verses.transliteration: avekṣamāṇastu tato dadarśa kapikuñjaraḥ ।rūpayauvanasaṁpannā rāvaṇasya varastiyaḥ ।। 5-18-26।।

translations.english: The leader of the monkeys started gazing at the chief wives of Ravana endowed with youth and beauty৷৷
translations.hindi: परम रूपवती स्त्रियों से घिरे हुए उस महातेजस्वी राक्षस-राज रावण | को, ताराप्रों से घिरे चन्द्रमा की तरह शोभित देख वृक्ष पर बेठे हुए पवननन्दन हनुमानजी ने सोचा कि, यह महाबाहु सवण ही है

verses.sloka: ताभिः परिवृतो राजा सुरूपाभिर्महायशाः ।तस्मृगद्विजसम्घष्टं प्रविष्टः प्रमदावनम् ।। ५-१८-२७।।
verses.transliteration: tābhiḥ parivṛto rājā surūpābhirmahāyaśāḥ ।tasmṛgadvijasamghaṣṭaṁ praviṣṭaḥ pramadāvanam ।। 5-18-27।।

translations.english: Surrounded by beauties, the glorious king entered the grove meant for women, reverberating with the sounds of beasts and birds.

verses.sloka: क्षीबो विचित्राभरणः शङ्कुकर्णो महाबलः ।तेन विश्रवसः पुत्रः स दृष्टो राक्षसाधिपः ।। ५-१८-२८।।
verses.transliteration: kṣībo vicitrābharaṇaḥ śaṅkukarṇo mahābalaḥ ।tena viśravasaḥ putraḥ sa dṛṣṭo rākṣasādhipaḥ ।। 5-18-28।।

translations.english: The brilliant vanara looked at the son of Visravas (Ravana), the demon king adorned with wonderful ornaments. He had long tapering ears. He was intoxicated with drink. Encircled by damsels, he was looking like the Moon surrounded by stars.
translations.hindi: उस समय महाबली, उन्मत्त, मूल्यवान गहनों को धारण किए हुए प्लोर अवे से कानों को स्तब्ध किए हुए, विश्रवा के पुत्र राक्षसराज रावण को हनुमानजी ने देखा

verses.sloka: वृतः परमनारीभिस्ताराभिरिव चन्द्रामाः ।तं ददर्श महातेजास्तेजोवन्तं महाकपिः ।। ५-१८-२९।।
verses.transliteration: vṛtaḥ paramanārībhistārābhiriva candrāmāḥ ।taṁ dadarśa mahātejāstejovantaṁ mahākapiḥ ।। 5-18-29।।

translations.english: The brilliant vanara looked at the son of Visravas (Ravana), the demon king adorned with wonderful ornaments. He had long tapering ears. He was intoxicated with drink. Encircled by damsels, he was looking like the Moon surrounded by stars.

verses.sloka: रावणोऽयम् महाबाहुरिति संचिन्त्य वानरः ।अवप्लुतो महातेजा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः ।। ५-१८-३०।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇo'yam mahābāhuriti saṁcintya vānaraḥ ।avapluto mahātejā hanumānmārutātmajaḥ ।। 5-18-30।।

translations.english: The brilliant vanara (Hanuman), son of the Windgod recognising the strongarmed Ravana got down a little, saying 'This is truly the strongarmed Ravana.'

verses.sloka: स तथाप्युग्रतेजाः सन्निर्धूतस्तस्य तेजसा ।पत्रगुह्यान्तरे सक्तो हनुमान् संवृतोऽभवत् ।। ५-१८-३१।।
verses.transliteration: sa tathāpyugratejāḥ sannirdhūtastasya tejasā ।patraguhyāntare sakto hanumān saṁvṛto'bhavat ।। 5-18-31।।

translations.english: Hanuman, possessed of extraordinary energy, was taken aback at the might of Ravana. He remained hiding covered over with leaves.
translations.hindi: यद्यपि हनुमानजी स्वयं भी अत्यन्त तेजस्वी थे, तथापि रावण के तेज के सामने वे दब गए और वृक्ष की एक डाली पर, उसके सघन पत्तों में क्षपने को छिपा लिया

verses.sloka: स तामसितकेशान्तां सुश्रोणीं संहतस्तनीम् ।दिदृक्षुरसितापाङ्गमुपावर्तत रावणः ।। ५-१८-३२
verses.transliteration: sa tāmasitakeśāntāṁ suśroṇīṁ saṁhatastanīm ।didṛkṣurasitāpāṅgamupāvartata rāvaṇaḥ ।। 5-18-32

translations.english: With the desire to see Sita endowed with black hair, beautiful hips, plump breasts and dark sideglances, Ravana returned (to Ashokavana). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टादशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the eighteenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
